title.en: Read a paper back to its sources

steps.zh: 先读问题、论点和结尾，标出作者真正回应的争论
steps.en: Identify the question, claim and debate before reading in detail

steps.zh: 追查一个关键引文的原典、版本和上下文
steps.en: Trace one important quotation to its primary text, edition and context

steps.zh: 写下可借鉴的论证方法与一处不同意见
steps.en: Note a useful argumentative move and one point of disagreement

output.zh: 文献卡：问题、论点、原典、可用位置
output.en: A reading card with question, claim, sources and possible use

check.zh: 页码、版本和引文语境相互对应
check.en: Match page numbers, editions and quotation context

steps.zh: 列出主张、分论点、证据与反例
steps.en: List the claim, subclaims, evidence and counterexamples

steps.zh: 用箭头区分支持、转折和前提关系
steps.en: Use arrows to distinguish support, contrast and prerequisites

steps.zh: 在缺少依据的连线上标记待补材料
steps.en: Mark links that still need supporting evidence

output.zh: 论证图、概念图或历史时间线
output.en: An argument map, concept map or timeline

check.zh: 图中的连接能对应到原文或明确解释
check.en: Trace each connection to a text or an explicit interpretation

steps.zh: 把读过的材料按观点或问题分组
steps.en: Group reading by position or question

steps.zh: 比较共识、分歧及使用材料的差别
steps.en: Compare agreement, disagreement and differences in evidence

steps.zh: 用一段话说明自己的切入点和仍缺的材料
steps.en: State your entry point and the evidence still needed

output.zh: 主题综述页与引用索引
output.en: A thematic synthesis with a citation index

check.zh: 按问题组织观点，保留不同解释
check.en: Organize around questions while retaining competing interpretations

steps.zh: 用自己的话定义论文中的一个核心概念
steps.en: Define a central concept in your own words

steps.zh: 找一个不符合现有解释的例子
steps.en: Find a case that does not fit the current interpretation

steps.zh: 据此收紧问题或补充适用边界
steps.en: Narrow the question or refine its limits

output.zh: 概念定义、反例与修订后的问题
output.en: A definition, counterexample and revised question

check.zh: 分清原作者用法与自己的分析用法
check.en: Separate the source author’s usage from your analytical usage

steps.zh: 选一条可核查的结论，列出论文使用的原始材料
steps.en: Choose a checkable claim and list its primary evidence

steps.zh: 按作者顺序重做引文定位、文本比较或编码
steps.en: Repeat source lookup, textual comparison or coding in the author’s sequence

steps.zh: 记录能够重现的步骤、差异和缺少的信息
steps.en: Record reproduced steps, differences and missing information

output.zh: 论证重建与差异记录
output.en: An argument reconstruction and discrepancy log

check.zh: 区分重现原论证与赞同其结论
check.en: Distinguish retracing the argument from accepting its conclusion

title.zh: 试做一个分析或创作小样
title.en: Pilot an analysis or creative fragment

steps.zh: 挑一小段文本、一个片段或一个创作问题
steps.en: Choose a short text, passage or creative question

steps.zh: 试用已经选定的分析规则或创作方法，保留旧版本
steps.en: Try the selected analytical or creative method and retain the prior version

steps.zh: 记录方法是否可执行以及哪里需要调整
steps.en: Note feasibility and changes needed

output.zh: 小样、标注样例与方法反思
output.en: A pilot fragment, annotation example and method reflection

check.zh: 把试做经验与正式研究结论分开
check.en: Keep pilot observations separate from final research conclusions

title.en: Check a corpus or processing script

steps.zh: 已有数字工具任务时，准备一份小规模测试文本
steps.en: For an existing digital task, prepare a small test text

steps.zh: 检查编码、分词、检索或标注的实际输出
steps.en: Inspect encoding, tokenization, search or annotation output

steps.zh: 手工复核几个样例，保存参数和改动
steps.en: Manually verify examples and save parameters and changes

output.zh: 工具检查记录与可复查样例
output.en: A tool-check log and inspectable examples

check.zh: 数字处理结果能回到原文，异常字符不被静默丢弃
check.en: Trace processed output to the original and detect lost characters

steps.zh: 先写一句主张，再选最直接的文本依据
steps.en: State a claim and select direct textual support

steps.zh: 补充从引文到主张之间的解释
steps.en: Explain the connection between the evidence and claim

steps.zh: 核查引用并写出与下一段的衔接
steps.en: Check citations and connect the next paragraph

output.zh: 带完整出处的段落草稿
output.en: A paragraph draft with complete references

check.zh: 段落包含主张、证据和解释
check.en: Include a claim, evidence and interpretation

steps.zh: 选一段卡住的论证，附上相关原文
steps.en: Choose a difficult argument and attach the relevant source text

steps.zh: 提出一个明确问题，而非泛泛询问写得怎样
steps.en: Ask one precise question about it

steps.zh: 把反馈转成可以执行的改写或补证任务
steps.en: Turn feedback into a specific revision or evidence task

output.zh: 讨论问题与修改清单
output.en: A discussion question and revision list

check.zh: 保留反馈理由与自己的取舍
check.en: Record the reasons for feedback and your decisions

steps.zh: 提取研究问题、理论机制、样本和核心变量
steps.en: Extract the question, mechanism, sample and key variables

steps.zh: 核对识别或解释策略依赖哪些条件
steps.en: Identify the assumptions behind identification or interpretation

steps.zh: 记录局限、可迁移部分及与自己项目的差别
steps.en: Note limits, transferable ideas and differences from your project

output.zh: 问题—机制—方法文献卡
output.en: A question, mechanism and method reading card

check.zh: 把作者报告的证据与自己的延伸解释分开
check.en: Separate reported evidence from your extrapolation

steps.zh: 先明确要表达的是机制、样本结构还是结果比较
steps.en: Choose whether the figure explains a mechanism, sample or comparison

steps.zh: 画机制图、样本流程图、系数图或主题关系图
steps.en: Create a mechanism, sample-flow, coefficient or theme diagram

steps.zh: 补上分母、单位、区间及图注来源
steps.en: Add denominators, units, intervals and source notes

output.zh: 一张可解释的机制或结果图
output.en: An interpretable mechanism or results figure

check.zh: 相关关系图不自动代表因果关系
check.en: Do not label an association diagram as causal evidence

title.zh: 把结果写成研究备忘录
title.en: Turn results into a research memo

steps.zh: 归纳目前最稳定的发现和不一致结果
steps.en: Summarize stable findings and inconsistent results

steps.zh: 对照理论机制和替代解释
steps.en: Compare mechanisms and alternative explanations

steps.zh: 列出需要补的材料、分析或访谈问题
steps.en: List remaining evidence, analyses or interview questions

output.zh: 发现—解释—下一步备忘录
output.en: A findings, interpretation and next-step memo

check.zh: 同时保留不支持原预期的证据
check.en: Retain evidence that does not support the initial expectation

steps.zh: 写清你希望解释的现象与比较对象
steps.en: Specify the phenomenon and comparison

steps.zh: 列出可能的混杂、选择过程或竞争机制
steps.en: List potential confounding, selection or competing mechanisms

steps.zh: 选择一项可区分解释的资料或核查
steps.en: Choose evidence or a check that separates explanations

output.zh: 解释假设与证据需求表
output.en: An explanation and evidence-needs table

check.zh: 把可检验判断与价值判断分开
check.en: Separate testable claims from value judgments

title.zh: 复现一张表或一段编码
title.en: Reproduce a table or coding step

steps.zh: 定位论文的样本筛选、变量口径与代码或编码规则
steps.en: Locate sample rules, variable definitions and code or coding rules

steps.zh: 用可获得且有权使用的材料重做一个主要结果
steps.en: Reproduce one main result using available authorized material

steps.zh: 逐项比较样本量、统计量或主题划分的差异
steps.en: Compare sample counts, statistics or thematic differences

output.zh: 复现表与差异说明
output.en: A reproduction table and discrepancy notes

check.zh: 资料或细节不足时，写清复现到哪一步
check.en: State the reproduced scope when data or details are missing

title.en: Pilot a questionnaire or interview workflow

steps.zh: 对照既定研究方案检查条目、顺序与记录表
steps.en: Check items, order and forms against the established plan

steps.zh: 在授权范围内进行小范围预试或桌面演练
steps.en: Run an authorized small pilot or a desk-based walkthrough

steps.zh: 记录歧义、流程阻塞与需要调整的内容
steps.en: Record ambiguity, bottlenecks and proposed changes

output.zh: 预试记录与工具修订表
output.en: A pilot log and instrument revision sheet

check.zh: 正式招募和资料收集遵循既定审批与同意流程
check.en: Use the established approval and consent process for actual recruitment and collection

title.zh: 调通一段数据处理代码

steps.zh: 保留原始数据，准备最小输入样例
steps.en: Preserve raw data and prepare a minimal input example

steps.zh: 逐步检查合并键、缺失处理、编码和样本筛选
steps.en: Check join keys, missingness, coding and sample filters step by step

steps.zh: 加一项样本量或取值范围检查并记录版本
steps.en: Add a sample-count or value-range check and record the version

output.zh: 处理日志、检查结果与修订脚本
output.en: Processing logs, checks and a revised script

check.zh: 能解释每一步为什么增加或减少了样本
check.en: Explain why each step changes the sample

title.zh: 写清一项发现及其边界
title.en: Write a finding and its limits

steps.zh: 选一项结果，先写其回答了什么问题
steps.en: Choose a result and state which question it answers

steps.zh: 连接表格、机制解释和相关文献
steps.en: Connect the table, mechanism and literature

steps.zh: 补充适用人群、样本和识别局限
steps.en: State population, sample and identification limits

output.zh: 结果或讨论段落草稿
output.en: A results or discussion paragraph

check.zh: 结论强度与设计和证据一致
check.en: Match claim strength to design and evidence

title.en: Turn a dependency into a precise question

steps.zh: 整理访谈、数据或合作环节的一个阻塞点
steps.en: Identify one interview, data or collaboration bottleneck

steps.zh: 准备简短背景、已有尝试与需要决定的选项
steps.en: Prepare context, attempted steps and decision options

steps.zh: 记录反馈并安排可独立推进的下一步
steps.en: Record feedback and identify an independent next step

output.zh: 待确认问题与独立推进项
output.en: An open question and independent next step

check.zh: 讨论准备不等于已联系或已获同意
check.en: Preparing a discussion does not mean contact or approval occurred

steps.zh: 提取核心问题、符号定义和关键假设
steps.en: Extract the problem, notation and key assumptions

steps.zh: 沿一条推导或实验结果检查支撑链
steps.en: Follow one derivation or experimental result through its evidence

steps.zh: 记录可检验预测、边界情况和未解释现象
steps.en: Note testable predictions, boundary cases and unexplained observations

output.zh: 模型与证据阅读卡
output.en: A model and evidence reading card

check.zh: 区分证明、数值证据与经验观察
check.en: Distinguish proof, numerical evidence and observation

steps.zh: 明确变量、单位和需要展示的关系
steps.en: Define variables, units and the relationship to display

steps.zh: 绘制示意图、相图、拟合图或误差图
steps.en: Create a schematic, phase diagram, fit or error plot

steps.zh: 标注条件、误差来源与图中不可外推的范围
steps.en: Annotate conditions, error sources and extrapolation limits

output.zh: 带条件与单位的研究图
output.en: A figure with conditions and units

check.zh: 从图回查原始值、模型参数与绘图设置
check.en: Trace the figure to raw values, model parameters and plot settings

steps.zh: 列出已经完成的推导、验证和观察
steps.en: List completed derivations, checks and observations

steps.zh: 把缺口按假设、方法和数据分组
steps.en: Group gaps by assumptions, methods and data

steps.zh: 写出下一项最有区分度的验证
steps.en: Describe the next discriminating check

output.zh: 已证—待证—验证路线表
output.en: An established, open and validation map

check.zh: 不要把尚未验证的猜想写成事实
check.en: Keep untested conjectures distinct from facts

steps.zh: 把关键关系写成最简形式
steps.en: Write the central relation in its simplest form

steps.zh: 检查极限、特殊情形、对称性或反例
steps.en: Inspect limits, special cases, symmetry or counterexamples

steps.zh: 据此修订假设或提出一个明确问题
steps.en: Refine an assumption or formulate a precise question

output.zh: 边界分析与问题便笺
output.en: A boundary-case analysis and question note

check.zh: 每个推论都写明使用的条件
check.en: State the conditions used for each inference

title.zh: 重现一个推导或基准结果

steps.zh: 收集原文定义、参数、条件与可用资料
steps.en: Collect definitions, parameters, conditions and available material

steps.zh: 从最小例子重做一段证明、计算或公开数据分析
steps.en: Reproduce a proof segment, calculation or public-data analysis from a minimal case

steps.zh: 比较结果和误差，定位最早出现差异的步骤
steps.en: Compare results and errors; locate the first divergence

output.zh: 复现笔记与差异定位
output.en: Reproduction notes and a divergence analysis

check.zh: 保持条件一致并记录无法获得的细节
check.en: Keep conditions aligned and record unavailable details

title.zh: 推进已定实验并留好记录
title.en: Advance an established experiment with traceable records

steps.zh: 对照既定方案核对预约、样本、对照与记录准备
steps.en: Check bookings, samples, controls and forms against the established protocol

steps.zh: 按既定流程开展已安排工作，保留原始读数和条件
steps.en: Carry out the scheduled work under that protocol and retain raw readings and conditions

steps.zh: 整理批次、异常与下一步核查项
steps.en: Organize batches, anomalies and follow-up checks

output.zh: 实验日志与原始数据索引
output.en: An experiment log and raw-data index

check.zh: 理论项目可转为数值试验；连续流程按原方案执行
check.en: For theoretical work use a numerical check; follow established continuous procedures

steps.zh: 固定输入、环境和参数，选一个可手算的小例子
steps.en: Fix inputs, environment and parameters; choose a hand-checkable case

steps.zh: 定位单位、边界条件、数值精度或索引问题
steps.en: Inspect units, boundaries, numerical precision or indexing

steps.zh: 保存最小测试与修订前后的结果
steps.en: Save the minimal test and before-and-after results

output.zh: 最小测试与计算修订记录
output.en: A minimal test and computation revision log

check.zh: 结果变化能够解释，不只以代码运行成功为标准
check.en: Explain result changes rather than relying only on successful execution

steps.zh: 先写问题、条件和结果各一句
steps.en: State the question, conditions and result

steps.zh: 补齐必要推导、图表或数据来源
steps.en: Add the required derivation, figure or data source

steps.zh: 交代误差、未证部分和适用范围
steps.en: Describe error, unproved parts and scope

output.zh: 带条件与验证的结果段
output.en: A results passage with conditions and validation

check.zh: 符号、单位、图表与文字一致
check.en: Align notation, units, figures and prose

steps.zh: 准备可独立阅读的问题、推导或异常图
steps.en: Prepare a self-contained question, derivation or anomaly plot

steps.zh: 列出尝试过的路径及各自卡在哪里
steps.en: List attempted approaches and where each stalled

steps.zh: 把反馈转成下一项可验证的任务
steps.en: Turn feedback into a verifiable next task

output.zh: 讨论页与下一项验证
output.en: A discussion sheet and next validation step

check.zh: 保留暂未解决的问题与不同判断
check.en: Retain unresolved questions and differing interpretations

steps.zh: 提取任务、系统假设、主要结构与评价指标
steps.en: Extract the task, system assumptions, design and metrics

steps.zh: 检查实现细节、数据、设备或资源条件
steps.en: Inspect implementation, data, equipment and resources

steps.zh: 记录值得验证的改动及公平比较的前提
steps.en: Record a testable change and the requirements for fair comparison

output.zh: 方法—实现—评价阅读卡
output.en: A method, implementation and evaluation card

check.zh: 区分论文声称、实际设置和自己的推测
check.en: Separate reported claims, actual settings and your assumptions

title.en: Visualize a system and its performance

steps.zh: 先选系统结构、流程、性能还是错误案例
steps.en: Choose architecture, workflow, performance or failure cases

steps.zh: 用已有数据绘制结构图、对比图或误差分布
steps.en: Draw an architecture diagram, comparison or error distribution from existing data

steps.zh: 标注版本、指标方向、单位和比较条件
steps.en: Label versions, metric direction, units and comparison conditions

output.zh: 结构图或可追溯性能图
output.en: An architecture diagram or traceable performance figure

check.zh: 图中的比较使用一致口径和明确的数据版本
check.en: Use consistent comparisons and explicit data versions

steps.zh: 列出本轮结构、参数、代码或材料的实际改动
steps.en: List actual design, parameter, code or material changes

steps.zh: 把每项改动与对应测试、性能和失败案例连接
steps.en: Link changes to tests, performance and failures

steps.zh: 确定值得保留的改动与下一轮验证点
steps.en: Choose changes to retain and the next validation target

output.zh: 改动—结果—决策记录
output.en: A change, result and decision log

check.zh: 保留无收益或负向结果，避免只记录最佳运行
check.en: Retain neutral and negative results as well as the best run

steps.zh: 从日志、性能或失败案例描述问题
steps.en: Describe the problem using logs, metrics or failures

steps.zh: 列出可能原因和能够区分它们的检查
steps.en: List possible causes and discriminating checks

steps.zh: 优先选择成本可控的一项验证
steps.en: Choose one check within the available budget

output.zh: 瓶颈假设与验证顺序
output.en: A bottleneck hypothesis and validation order

check.zh: 先区分问题成因，再决定是否增加复杂度
check.en: Separate causes before adding complexity

steps.zh: 固定论文、代码提交、环境、数据划分和配置
steps.en: Fix the paper, code revision, environment, data split and configuration

steps.zh: 先跑最小用例，再在预算内复现一个主要指标
steps.en: Run a minimal case, then reproduce a main metric within budget

steps.zh: 比较日志和结果，记录差异及复现范围
steps.en: Compare logs and results and document differences and scope

output.zh: 基线运行清单与差异报告
output.en: A baseline run manifest and discrepancy report

check.zh: 核对比较条件、随机性和数据泄漏风险
check.en: Check comparison conditions, randomness and data leakage

steps.zh: 对照既定方案明确变量、对照与资源预算
steps.en: Define variables, controls and resources using the established plan

steps.zh: 执行已安排的性能测试、仿真或消融，完整保存日志
steps.en: Run the scheduled test, simulation or ablation and retain full logs

steps.zh: 比较改动前后并标记不稳定或异常结果
steps.en: Compare before and after and flag unstable or anomalous results

output.zh: 测试或消融记录与结果对照
output.en: A test or ablation log and comparison

check.zh: 设备、连续实验和安全条件按既定方案执行
check.en: Follow established equipment, continuous-experiment and safety procedures

steps.zh: 保存当前版本，提取能稳定触发问题的最小输入
steps.en: Save the current version and isolate a reproducible minimal input

steps.zh: 定位首次偏离预期的步骤，每次只改一个关键因素
steps.en: Locate the first unexpected step and change one key factor at a time

steps.zh: 运行相关回归检查，记录修复依据与影响
steps.en: Run relevant regression checks and record the fix and its impact

output.zh: 最小复现、修订代码与测试记录
output.en: A minimal reproduction, revised code and test log

check.zh: 确认问题已解决且相邻功能仍可用
check.en: Confirm the issue is resolved and adjacent behavior still works

title.en: Connect the method to its evaluation

steps.zh: 用一段话说明方法解决什么问题
steps.en: Explain what problem the method addresses

steps.zh: 逐项对应结构、实现设置与实验验证
steps.en: Connect architecture, implementation and evaluation

steps.zh: 核对图表、版本、指标及资源说明
steps.en: Check figures, versions, metrics and resource descriptions

output.zh: 方法或实验段落草稿
output.en: A methods or evaluation draft

check.zh: 避免遗漏使结果无法复查的设置
check.en: Include settings needed to inspect the result

title.en: Organize a discussion around a failure

steps.zh: 准备一个代表性失败、日志或性能图
steps.en: Prepare a representative failure, log or performance figure

steps.zh: 列出已排除的原因与剩余假设
steps.en: List ruled-out causes and remaining hypotheses

steps.zh: 记录下一步谁需要确认什么以及可独立执行的检查
steps.en: Record decisions to confirm and checks that can proceed independently

output.zh: 问题定位页与行动清单
output.en: A diagnosis sheet and action list

check.zh: 讨论材料包含复现条件与实际证据
check.en: Include reproduction conditions and evidence

title.zh: 读清对象、环境与试验设计
title.en: Read the organism, environment and study design

steps.zh: 提取物种或品种、环境、物候与研究问题
steps.en: Extract species or cultivar, environment, phenology and question

steps.zh: 核对处理、重复、观察周期及样本单位
steps.en: Check treatments, replicates, observation periods and sample units

steps.zh: 记录可借鉴的方法与当地条件的差别
steps.en: Note useful methods and differences from local conditions

output.zh: 对象—环境—方法文献卡
output.en: An organism, environment and method card

check.zh: 区分不同地点、季节和处理条件下的结论
check.en: Keep location, season and treatment differences explicit

title.zh: 画出地块、物候与样本关系

steps.zh: 核对地块或个体编号、处理和采样日期
steps.en: Check plot or individual identifiers, treatments and dates

steps.zh: 画样地布局、物候时间线或响应变化图
steps.en: Draw a plot layout, phenology timeline or response plot

steps.zh: 标注环境变化、缺测与重复结构
steps.en: Annotate environmental changes, missingness and replication

output.zh: 样地或物候图与数据说明
output.en: A plot or phenology figure with data notes

check.zh: 图中编号能追溯到现场和原始记录
check.en: Trace identifiers to field sites and original records

steps.zh: 对齐采样、环境、处理与观测记录
steps.en: Align sampling, environmental, treatment and observation records

steps.zh: 整理异常、偏离方案与需要补充的元数据
steps.en: Document anomalies, deviations and missing metadata

steps.zh: 写下下一窗口的准备项与交接信息
steps.en: List preparations and handover notes for the next window

output.zh: 完整台账、异常清单与交接页
output.en: A ledger, anomaly list and handover sheet

check.zh: 原始值、编号和时间记录保持可追溯
check.en: Keep raw values, identifiers and times traceable

title.zh: 区分处理效应与环境变化

steps.zh: 选择一个变化明显的观察结果
steps.en: Choose an observation with a noticeable change

steps.zh: 比较处理、环境、物候与测量条件的解释
steps.en: Compare treatment, environment, phenology and measurement explanations

steps.zh: 列出能区分这些解释的记录或观察
steps.en: List records or observations that distinguish them

output.zh: 环境与处理解释便笺
output.en: An environment and treatment interpretation note

check.zh: 不把单次观察直接推广到其他季节或地点
check.en: Avoid generalizing a single observation across seasons or sites

title.zh: 复查一项分析或记录流程
title.en: Reproduce an analysis or recording workflow

steps.zh: 选论文中的一项统计、指标计算或观测编码
steps.en: Select a statistic, index calculation or observation coding step

steps.zh: 使用可获得材料重做计算并核对单位和分母
steps.en: Repeat the calculation with available material and check units and denominators

steps.zh: 记录环境或样本条件不一致带来的差异
steps.en: Record differences in environmental or sample conditions

output.zh: 复核表与适用条件说明
output.en: A reproduction table and applicability notes

check.zh: 数值重现与现场条件重现分别说明
check.en: Distinguish numerical reproduction from reproducing field conditions

title.zh: 按真实窗口推进采样与试验
title.en: Work within real sampling and trial windows

steps.zh: 按已定方案核对物候、预约、样本编号和设备准备
steps.en: Check phenology, bookings, identifiers and equipment under the established plan

steps.zh: 完成既定采样或观测，记录现场条件与偏差
steps.en: Perform scheduled sampling or observation and record conditions and deviations

steps.zh: 检查样本交接、保存记录与原始数据备份
steps.en: Check handover, storage records and raw-data backups

output.zh: 当次采样或试验记录包
output.en: A sampling or trial record package

check.zh: 必要采样、照护和连续观测以实际方案为准
check.en: Use actual protocols for essential sampling, care and continuous observation

title.zh: 调通样本与观测数据整理

steps.zh: 用少量记录检查地块、个体和时间键
steps.en: Check plot, individual and time keys on a small sample

steps.zh: 核对单位换算、重复记录和缺测标记
steps.en: Check unit conversions, duplicates and missing-data flags

steps.zh: 对照原始台账验证输出并保存处理说明
steps.en: Verify output against the source ledger and save processing notes

output.zh: 清洗脚本与台账核对结果
output.en: A cleaning script and ledger cross-check

check.zh: 保留原始记录，避免误合并不同个体或时间
check.en: Preserve originals and avoid merging distinct individuals or times

steps.zh: 说明地点、对象、时间、处理和样本单位
steps.en: Describe site, organism, time, treatments and sample units

steps.zh: 把结果与环境背景和既有研究对应
steps.en: Connect results to environmental context and prior work

steps.zh: 交代缺测、偏差与结论适用条件
steps.en: Document missingness, deviations and applicability

output.zh: 方法或结果段落与条件表
output.en: A methods or results passage and conditions table

check.zh: 条件描述足以理解比较和结论范围
check.en: Describe conditions well enough to assess comparisons and scope

steps.zh: 整理真实物候、已定任务与所需资源
steps.en: Summarize phenology, scheduled tasks and resources

steps.zh: 列出样本、设备或交接中待确认的事项
steps.en: List sampling, equipment or handover decisions

steps.zh: 保留可独立完成的整理任务作为衔接
steps.en: Keep an independent documentation task available

output.zh: 窗口准备与交接清单
output.en: A window-preparation and handover checklist

check.zh: 准备清单不替代实际预约或现场判断
check.en: A preparation list does not replace bookings or field judgment

steps.zh: 提取研究人群或样本、设计、暴露和结局
steps.en: Extract population or samples, design, exposures and outcomes

steps.zh: 核对纳排、观察期、对照及主要分析
steps.en: Check eligibility, follow-up, controls and primary analyses

steps.zh: 记录偏倚、适用范围与和本项目的差异
steps.en: Record bias concerns, applicability and project differences

output.zh: 设计—结局—局限文献卡
output.en: A design, outcome and limitations card

check.zh: 研究证据整理不直接转成诊疗结论
check.en: Keep evidence organization distinct from clinical decisions

steps.zh: 确定展示病例流程、时间窗、样本关系还是结果
steps.en: Choose case flow, time windows, sample relationships or results

steps.zh: 用已有数据制作流程图、时间线或带区间的结果图
steps.en: Use existing data for a flowchart, timeline or result figure with intervals

steps.zh: 核对分母、编号、单位、时间起点和图注
steps.en: Check denominators, identifiers, units, time origins and captions

output.zh: 病例或样本流程图、时间线或结果图
output.en: A case or sample flowchart, timeline or result figure

check.zh: 保持匿名化，图中数字能回查到分析记录
check.en: Maintain de-identification and trace numbers to analysis records

steps.zh: 汇总定义已明确、数据已核查和仍有缺口的部分
steps.en: Summarize resolved definitions, checked data and remaining gaps

steps.zh: 对照主要发现、偏倚与替代解释
steps.en: Compare main findings, bias concerns and alternatives

steps.zh: 生成下一轮资料核查或写作的具体问题
steps.en: List specific queries or writing questions for the next round

output.zh: 研究备忘录与待核查表
output.en: A research memo and query list

check.zh: 明确哪些已核实、哪些仍待确认
check.en: Distinguish verified items from open queries

title.zh: 想清时间顺序与解释边界
title.en: Think through temporal order and interpretation

steps.zh: 画出暴露、索引日期、检测或随访与结局的顺序
steps.en: Map exposure, index date, measurement or follow-up and outcome order

steps.zh: 列出选择、测量、批次或混杂的可能影响
steps.en: List possible selection, measurement, batch or confounding effects

steps.zh: 选择已有资料能支持的一项核查
steps.en: Choose one check supported by existing evidence

output.zh: 时间关系图与解释问题清单
output.en: A temporal map and interpretation questions

check.zh: 不以未经核实的研究推断改变诊疗或实验方案
check.en: Keep unverified research inferences separate from care or protocol changes

title.zh: 复现一个研究结果或分析步骤
title.en: Reproduce a research result or analysis step

steps.zh: 定位论文定义、处理规则、代码及可用公开资料
steps.en: Locate definitions, processing rules, code and available public material

steps.zh: 在有权使用的数据上重做一个统计、图表或预处理步骤
steps.en: Repeat a statistic, figure or preprocessing step using authorized data

steps.zh: 比较样本量、时间定义和结果，记录差异
steps.en: Compare sample counts, temporal definitions and results; document differences

output.zh: 复现记录、结果对照与差异说明
output.en: A reproduction log, comparison and discrepancy notes

check.zh: 不把无法获得的数据或参数假定为已知
check.en: Keep unavailable data and parameters explicitly unresolved

title.zh: 推进已定研究操作与记录
title.en: Advance established research procedures and records

steps.zh: 区分临床资料整理与实验室任务，核对对应方案和权限
steps.en: Distinguish clinical-record work from lab tasks and check the relevant plan and access

steps.zh: 按既定安排处理研究记录或开展已批准实验，保留编号、批次和原始记录
steps.en: Follow the schedule for records or approved experiments and retain identifiers, batches and raw records

steps.zh: 整理缺项、异常、对照和交接事项
steps.en: Organize missing items, anomalies, controls and handover notes

output.zh: 研究日志、样本或病例核查表
output.en: A research log and sample or case checklist

check.zh: 诊疗、照护、连续实验与随访按实际既定方案执行
check.en: Follow established care, continuous-experiment and follow-up commitments

title.zh: 调试变量构建与分析流程

steps.zh: 使用脱敏或合成小样例核对病例、样本和日期键
steps.en: Use de-identified or synthetic examples to check case, sample and date keys

steps.zh: 检查单位、时间窗、缺失标记、排除规则和数据划分
steps.en: Inspect units, windows, missingness, exclusions and data splits

steps.zh: 核对流程计数与结果，保存代码版本及检查日志
steps.en: Verify flow counts and results; save code versions and check logs

output.zh: 分析脚本、流程计数与检查日志
output.en: An analysis script, flow counts and check log

check.zh: 避免编号错配、时间穿越或数据泄漏
check.en: Check identifier mismatches, temporal leakage and data leakage

title.en: Write the design, findings and limits

steps.zh: 选定一项发现，明确对应人群或样本与分析
steps.en: Choose a finding and specify its population or samples and analysis

steps.zh: 对齐正文、表图、结局定义和数值
steps.en: Align prose, tables, figures, outcome definitions and numbers

steps.zh: 说明研究设计能支持的解释范围及局限
steps.en: State the interpretation and limits supported by the design

output.zh: 可核查的结果或讨论段落
output.en: An inspectable results or discussion passage

check.zh: 结论强度与证据相称，术语和数字一致
check.en: Match claims to evidence and keep terminology and numbers consistent

title.zh: 带着具体研究疑点交流

steps.zh: 准备匿名化的问题说明与相关记录位置
steps.en: Prepare a de-identified query and relevant record locations

steps.zh: 区分数据定义、分析方法和解释层面的疑点
steps.en: Separate definition, analysis and interpretation questions

steps.zh: 记录需要确认的判断和可继续推进的工作
steps.en: Record decisions to confirm and work that can continue

output.zh: 研究疑点与后续核查清单
output.en: A research query and follow-up checklist

check.zh: 交流材料只使用授权范围内的信息
check.en: Use information within the authorized scope
